title: OpenComputer
claim: Product Hunt: OpenComputer — The easiest way to deploy a managed agent.
why_good: The project addresses a growing need for simplified deployment of managed agents in complex infrastructures, appealing to teams with limited DevOps resources.
value: Businesses could pay for a subscription model based on the number of agents deployed, providing a steady revenue stream as they scale.
risk: The market is competitive, and larger cloud service providers could easily integrate similar features into their existing platforms.
evidence: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
method: producthunt api v2 (top launches, last 2d) + startup-worthiness score
